title: Taking an old open source football engine and trying to bring it to Android
author: Lazy-Librarian6753
selftext:
I've been working on Blurz Football, a native Android football game built with C++, SDL, JNI, and OpenGL ES.

It's based on the existing [GameplayFootball project](https://github.com/BazkieBumpercar/GameplayFootball) by Bastiaan Schuiling, including its original engine and game logic. I'm adapting it for Android and working on rendering, player models, and other improvements.

Most of my coding has been vibe-coding, and I'm still learning how the engine works. I'd appreciate feedback from people experienced with C++ game development and Android.

Here's the [repo](https://github.com/blurz17/blurz-native-football-)
